name: Launch Marketer
tagline: Gives your product a ready-to-post launch kit: positioning, posts, visuals and a launch film.
delivers: One-page positioning: who it's for, the problem, the one-line promise
Ready-to-post copy for X, Instagram and TikTok, plus a launch email
Social visuals and an ad-ready showcase image
A short animated launch film with an original soundtrack

brief.label: What are you launching? (link if it's live)
brief.example: possible.sh: AI agents you download and run in your own Claude Code or Codex

brief.label: Who should care, and what do they believe today?
brief.example: Founders who think AI agents only write code

brief.label: Facts you can back up
brief.example: 9 agents, US$19 each; every published result shows how it was made

limits: Delivers drafts and assets; it doesn't post, buy ads or contact anyone. Uses only claims you can back up.
checks: Checks claims against the supplied product facts.
Checks copy and assets for readability and file integrity.
refuses: Does not invent customers or numbers.
Does not use drawn substitutes for real brand assets.
